# Booth Design Karachi

> Booth Design Karachi is an exhibition stall design company based in PECHS, Karachi, Pakistan. It designs, fabricates and installs exhibition booths, exhibition stalls, custom exhibition stands and retail kiosks for brands exhibiting across Karachi, with Expo Centre Karachi as its primary venue focus.

Booth Design Karachi runs design and fabrication as a single process — concept, 3D design, sign-off, fabrication, installation and dismantling — for both raw-space and shell-scheme exhibition stands. Karachi, Pakistan is the primary service area.

Key facts:
- Name: Booth Design Karachi
- Services: exhibition booth design, exhibition stall design, exhibition stand fabrication, custom exhibition stands, kiosk design and fabrication
- Primary location: Office 505, 5th Floor, Business Avenue Building, Shahrah-e-Faisal, Block 6, PECHS, Karachi, Pakistan
- Phone / WhatsApp: +92 335 2428438
- Email: share@boothdesignkarachi.com
- Primary venue focus: Expo Centre Karachi, Gulshan-e-Iqbal

## Services

- [Exhibition Booth & Stall Design](https://boothdesignkarachi.com/exhibition-booth-stall-design.html): Layout planning, 3D concept design and branding for exhibition booths and stalls in Karachi, for shell-scheme and raw-space stands.
- [Exhibition Stall Fabrication in Karachi](https://boothdesignkarachi.com/exhibition-stall-fabrication-karachi.html): Build, on-site installation and dismantling of exhibition stands and booths for Karachi exhibitors — the main fabrication service page.
- [Custom Exhibition Stands](https://boothdesignkarachi.com/custom-exhibition-stands.html): Bespoke exhibition stand and stall design and build for raw space, double-storey and complex configurations.
- [Kiosk Design & Fabrication](https://boothdesignkarachi.com/kiosk-design.html): Design and fabrication of retail and mall kiosks, built for daily durability and brand consistency.
- [All Services](https://boothdesignkarachi.com/services.html): Overview of all exhibition booth, stall and kiosk services offered.
